TC1.title: Happy path - clean company
TC1.story: All documents agree, registries confirm, bank verified.

TC2.title: Inconsistent entity names
TC2.story: GST shows 'PVT. LTD.' (harmless); cancelled cheque is in the name 'Nimbus Freight Services' (needs clarification).

TC3.title: Bank account belongs to an existing vendor
TC3.story: Every document looks perfect, but the bank account already pays another vendor and the bank returns that vendor's name.

TC4.title: Missing + expired documents, then resubmission
TC4.story: No Certificate of Incorporation and an FSSAI licence that expired in March 2026. Resubmission TC4-R fixes both.

TC5.title: Poor-quality scanned bank proof
TC5.story: Sole proprietorship; the cheque is a blurry phone scan, account number unreadable. The system must not call it a mismatch.

TC6.title: Subsidiary paid into parent's account
TC6.story: A new subsidiary honestly declares it is paid into its parent's (an existing vendor's) account. Not fraud, but the classic diversion pattern: high-risk hold for Finance Controls. Under a stricter client policy it is rejected.
